heading: Benefits of each combination
text:
### Benefits of each combination [LNLS.8.2]

| Property | `realtime` alone | `linear_scan: false` alone | Both |
|---|---|---|---|
| Zero malloc in pump | ✓ | ✗ (ridx overflow still possible) | ✓ |
| Beta joins O(1) — J_max = 1 proven | ✗ (O(N_max) without identity join) | ✓ (LNLS.3.3 enforces) | ✓ |
| Series O(1) always | ✓ (sketch excluded by realtime) | ✓ | ✓ |
| Intern frozen | ✓ (locked by go_live) | ✓ (no novel strings) | ✓ |
| wm_dedup O(1) always | ✗ (all-tolerance schemas possible) | ✓ | ✓ |
| T_wcet N_max-independent for joins | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| String ops O(1) (capacity required) | ✗ | ✓ (LNLS.3.10) | ✓ |
| T_wcet finite and computable | ✓ | ✓ (larger beta term) | ✓ |
| go_live lifecycle required | ✓ | ✗ | ✓ |
| Pool allocation required | ✓ | ✗ | ✓ |
| JSON slots allowed | ✓ (with borrow semantics) | ✗ | ✗ |
| Range-only joins allowed | ✓ (bounded by N_max) | ✗ | ✗ |
